Production animation sprite atlas: SIX newly drawn poses of the exact female thunder goddess in original portrait1, seen FROM BEHIND looking NORTHWEST / screen UPPER-LEFT. The REAR THREE-QUARTER CAMERA is the primary requirement. BACK OF HEAD with gold bun/blue ribbon, BACK OF SHOULDERS and BLUE BACK BODICE dominate every figure. Her gaze travels upper-left AWAY from viewer. Front chest/breasts and face are hidden on far side. This is NOT a W side-facing character. Do not turn the head or torso toward viewer. Reference2 gives true rear joint placement and actual six WALK phases: faithfully preserve that heading, anatomical LEFT near/dark leg and RIGHT far/light leg. Do not copy diagram materials, stick limbs or annotations. Reference3 contains only actual gold/cyan staff and blue/gold coat details, NOT a full body or viewpoint.

Preserve the portrait body proportions and highly detailed clean isometric RPG material shading. Render the correct minimally inferred BACK of this same outfit, never replace with different armor, new ornament or a generic human. Back bodice is blue/gold, skirt rear white, hair bun/ribbons show their actual rear surfaces.

ONE rigid long GOLD double-ended spear/staff in anatomical RIGHT hand, which is the FAR hand for this camera. Place the right forearm and shaft in correct far-side depth, generally to screen RIGHT of the torso as indicated by the motion guide; do not put it in near LEFT hand. It has one pointed openwork gold upper spearhead and a cyan diamond gem beneath, long slender gold shaft, then a lower cyan gem and pointed gold counterweight. All complete tips remain visible, exact topology and length invariant. Anatomical near LEFT arm is free and naturally counter-swings. No second weapon, shield, horn, wing or invented attachment.

1024x1536 transparent atlas, EXACTLY2 columns and3 rows; SIX512x512 cells, time left-to-right then down. Each complete figure plus staff is about440-464pixels TALL, width <=320pixels, centered horizontally, all opaque tips inside its own cell, raw ground contact around y480. Keep at least16pixels vertical empty gutter. Large native detail matching saved high quality, not tiny320px figures. Same head/torso/limb dimensions in all6; no per-pose shrink, crop or overlap.

Six physically ordered WALK drawings following motion guide:0 near LEFT heel contacts FORWARD while far RIGHT toe pushes off BEHIND;1 LEFT midstance bearing weight, RIGHT knee/foot swings from behind through passage;2 LEFT terminal stance moving behind the hip, RIGHT swings forward preparing heel contact;3 far RIGHT heel contacts FORWARD while near LEFT toe pushes off BEHIND;4 RIGHT midstance with LEFT swinging through passage;5 RIGHT terminal stance while LEFT approaches its next forward heel contact. Support feet move progressively backward relative hips as body advances. Alternate actual legs without swapping identity; bend knees/hips, heel contact and toe-off visible; one support foot grounded each phase. Subtle bodybob and coat/ribbon follow-through, never hide the actual contact legs. Independently draw all6 physical poses, not recolors/translations/mirrors. Static standing or running flight is invalid.

Crisp hard opaque cutout sprites with rich interior shading, transparent alpha0 everywhere outside exact silhouettes and only1-2pixel antialias edge. No floor, cast shadow, aura, lightning cloud, particles, labels, grid, text or scenery. No visible front chest or side W face: clear literal NW BACK view in every cell.
